import curses
import time

def main(stdscr):
    curses.curs_set(0)  # Hide the cursor
    stdscr.keypad(True)  # Enable keyboard input
    stdscr.timeout(120)  # Set timeout for getch()

    # Define the grid size and initial position
    grid_size = 20
    snake = [(grid_size // 2, grid_size // 2)]
    direction = (0, 0)  # Initial direction: right

    # Define the key-to-direction map
    key_to_direction = {
        curses.KEY_UP: (0, -1),
        curses.KEY_DOWN: (0, 1),
        curses.KEY_LEFT: (-1, 0),
        curses.KEY_RIGHT: (1, 0)
    }

    # Define the game loop
    while True:
        # Get the user input
        key = stdscr.getch()
        if key in key_to_direction:
            direction = key_to_direction[key]

        # Update the snake position
        new_head = (snake[0][0] + direction[0], snake[0][1] + direction[1])
        snake.insert(0, new_head)

        # Check for collisions with the walls or itself
        if new_head[0] < 0 or new_head[0] >= grid_size or new_head[1] < 0 or new_head[1] >= grid_size or new_head in snake[1:]:
            break

        # Check for collisions with the food
        if new_head == (grid_size // 2, grid_size // 2):
            snake.append(snake[-1])  # Add a new segment to the snake
        else:
            snake.pop()  # Remove the tail segment of the snake

        # Clear the screen
        stdscr.clear()

        # Draw the grid
        for row in range(grid_size):
            for col in range(grid_size):
                if (row, col) in snake:
                    stdscr.addch(row, col, curses.ACS_CKBOARD)  # Draw snake
                elif (row, col) == (grid_size // 2, grid_size // 2):
                    stdscr.addch(row, col, curses.ACS_PI)  # Draw food
                else:
                    stdscr.addch(row, col, " ")  # Draw empty space

        # Refresh the screen
        stdscr.refresh()

        # Wait for the next frame
        time.sleep(0.1)

    # Clean up
    curses.curs_set(1)  # Show the cursor
    stdscr.keypad(False)
    curses.endwin()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    curses.wrapper(main)
